title: What if the next instruction doesn’t make sense yet?
paragraphs: What if the next instruction doesn’t make sense yet?

Philip was sent to a desert road.
No crowd.
No stage.
No applause.

Some people only move when it’s logical.
Others move when it’s clear.
And a few move when God says go.

It wasn’t strategic.
It wasn’t efficient.
It was obedient.

Sometimes the road that looks empty
is the one that changes everything.
Most people want clarity before commitment.
Philip got a direction — not details.

If you’re waiting for the full map,
you might miss the moment.
The road feels random… until later.
